verdict.rationale: The docs refer to an 'Unleash Open Source' edition and tell users to clone the Unleash repository to run the server, and community members treat github.com/Unleash/unleash as an open-source project, so the source is publicly readable. However, no evidence names the license or confirms which parts of the product (core versus Enterprise features) it covers, so the 'open license' part of the story is only implied. Missing for 10: a named open-source license (e.g., a LICENSE file or docs statement), clarity on whether Enterprise features fall outside the open-source code.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license

citations.quote: This guide helps you set up Unleash Open Source or Unleash Enterprise in your own environment using Docker.
To start the Unleash server, clone the Unleash repository and start the server with Docker Compose
Asked for an open-source, self-hosted alternative to LaunchDarkly, a commenter recommended Unleash (github.com/Unleash/unleash).
